Leah (oncall): seeing a sudden GPU attach backlog in us-west1-c, many pods stuck at Attaching >90s, kubelet logs show repeated block-device busy/EIO :grimacing:
Omar (storage): pulling device traces. cohort of drives hit an internal remap/rewrite phase triggered by vendor firmware when a series of snapshot commits overlapped with high metadata fsyncs. qdepth collapsed to 1
Diego (sre): did snapshot service retry aggressively? we had an upstream API flake ~02:09 that could've caused retries
snapshot-bot: noticed 502->retry loop hitting replica eu-west2 for snapshots 02:08-02:12. switching snapshot retries to exponential backoff and pausing sync commits for affected cohort :gear:
Omar (storage): logs show pattern: many small snapshot commits -> metadata fsyncs -> vendor remap locks -> async-trim starvation -> nvme qdepth collapse -> kubelet attach timeouts. sample:
```
[2026-05-11T02:09:53Z] snapshot: commit id=sn-42 sync
[2026-05-11T02:09:54Z] nvme0n1: remap_start extents=12000
[2026-05-11T02:09:55Z] kubelet: attach timeout pod=gpu-render-7
```
Leah (oncall): immediate mitigations? customers hitting failures now
infra-bot: recommended actions: 1) pause snapshot sync commits for `us-west1-c` for 15m 2) increase nodepool ioQuota to 1.8x 3) cordon worst-off hosts until qdepth stabilizes
Diego (sre): apply ioQuota bump and cordons, also extend kubelet attach timeout while recovery in progress
Leah (oncall): `kubectl patch nodepool us-west1-c-gpu --patch '{"spec":{"ioQuota":"180%"}}'` applied. cordoning 3 noisy nodes. extending attach timeout via configmap
metrics-bot: host-local-io-latency p50 rose 4ms->260ms at 02:09; device-qdepth median 128->1; attach_pending peaked 46
Omar (storage): short-term we throttled snapshot service and forced vendor remap backoff via a software toggle (vendor-compat: remap-yield=true). attach backlog trending down after 6m
Diego (sre): long-term fixes: 1) snapshot service -> async commits with jitter and replica-aware backoff 2) snapshot-bot: detect attach_pending>8 and automatically reduce snapshot concurrency 3) add a firmware-compat matrix test to catch remap escalations 4) cleaner: avoid issuing sync TRIMs during snapshot windows
Leah (oncall): filing INF-2026-FW-REMAP: RCA + action items + cost note. pausing sync commits increases short-term RPO risk but preserves provisioning SLA. keeping 30m watch. thanks team :relieved:
